note: Honest distance-to-world-class. 100 = a world-class homemade Premiere per the spec Definition of Done. ALL 8 spec phases are implemented (the spec is DONE), plus a real-use run: 9:16 Shorts format + aspect-correct export, audio auto-level, C=cut, a monitor transform gizmo + click-preview-to-select, add-track buttons. The remaining gap is ear/eye-gated quality, deeper perf (full proxy/streaming decode), and the Effects tab still being a stub. Never inflated to cross a review threshold. Scores below are a qualitative judgement call, dated to when they were last assessed by eye/ear; they are not re-measured by an automated check.

dimensions.label: Editing core (timeline, trim/split/ripple/roll/slip/slide, snapping, markers, multi-seq)
dimensions.left: Marquee multi-select; a track-height resize grip; roll/slide are engine+tests but not surfaced as dedicated UI.

dimensions.label: Export fidelity (real MP4, preview==export by construction)
dimensions.left: Worker pool / throughput tuning; AV1/HEVC honesty is stated but codec set is H.264-first.

dimensions.label: Effects, transitions, titles, color
dimensions.left: Color is lift/gamma/gain + white balance (no curves/scopes); effect/transition/title presets aren't drag-from-Effects-tab yet (Inspector instead).

dimensions.label: Audio (mixer, fades, waveforms, pan, meter, crossfade, reverse)
dimensions.left: EAR-GATED: mix/fade/pan math is built + tested + preview==export, but how it SOUNDS needs David's ears. No sub-mix buses, no EQ, master fader is unity (meter only).

dimensions.label: Performance on long/large media
dimensions.left: Preview decode now scales by quality tier (real scrub win). NOT done: full proxy transcode for the PLAYING path, and streaming audio decode (whole-file decode still costs memory on very long clips).

dimensions.label: UX, keyboard workflow, a11y
dimensions.left: Full keymap + a live help sheet + aria-live/roles. NOT axe-audited to 'axe-clean'; no first-run coach tour.

dimensions.label: Reliability (tests, autosave, crash recovery)
dimensions.left: 2851 vitest tests (2850 passing) as of 2026-09-25; the one failure is environment-only (electron/proxyTranscode.test.ts shells out to a Windows ffmpeg.exe, which does not run on this Linux checker). e2e count not re-verified here: Playwright is not run in this environment. More edge-case coverage on the new audio/color/speed paths would help.

dimensions.label: Design / craft (dark pro editor)
dimensions.left: Cohesive dark theme, real waveforms, machined controls. Eye-gated polish pass + an icon/spacing sweep would lift it further.

ear_eye_gated: Audio mix/kit sound quality (needs David's ears)
autonomous_ceiling: The spec is complete (2850 of 2851 vitest tests passing as of 2026-09-25; the one failure is the environment-only ffmpeg.exe case above, not a code regression; e2e count not re-verified here). The last ~5 points: (1) ear-gated audio sound quality, (2) full proxy media + streaming audio decode for very long media, (3) the Effects tab is still a stub saying "Arriving in Phase 4" (effects work only via the Inspector; no drag-onto-clip flow), (4) axe a11y + eye-gated design polish.
